title: Accept hosted OCR safety, user correction, accessibility and rollout matrix
baseCommit: af515455 (KAN-194 VOCR-03 head; composes the VOCR-01 OCR contract + VOCR-03 provenance routing chain)
module: ml/vmm/ocracceptance.py (+ ml/vmm/tests/test_ocracceptance.py); NO source changes to ocr.py/ocrouting.py
whatBuilt: REVIEW/REPAIR: the missing layer between VOCR-01 raw hypotheses (never authoritative) and VOCR-03 routing (refuses unreviewed results) — owner-only review binds every correction to an exact (page, region) of the transcript, injection-scans corrected text like perception text, and yields a reviewed result the real OcrProvenanceRouter accepts; review is idempotent by transcript fingerprint

CORRECTION INVALIDATION: a new correction supersedes every routed proposal captured at an earlier correction sequence; re-routing the stale transcript is refused (fail closed) and only the repaired transcript routes again

OWNERSHIP/REVOCATION/EXPIRY: cross-owner review/registration/revocation refused; owner or system revocation and permission expiry invalidate the interpretation and mark every routed payload invalidated immediately

ROLLOUT MATRIX: per-locale gates with required-vs-expansion modalities (CER/WER thresholds, minimum sample bound) — English is the launch locale and a failing required modality BLOCKS the model release; non-English locales register as disabled expansion cases that stay visibly unavailable and never block launch; disable() is fail-closed for review AND routing; rollback(version) restores the exact prior matrix state deterministically
REDACTED OBSERVABILITY: append-only event log carries ids/hashes/counts only (probe-proven: no event may carry OCR text or correction text)
CROSS-DEVICE RECOVERY: harness state reconstructs deterministically from the event log (replay_state)
